title: FBI: von Braun sent classified documents to the USSR

tellings.quote: FBI documents even showed that at one point von Braun was caught sending classified documents to his Nazi counterparts in the USSR, but it seemed like no disciplinary action was ever taken.

related.note: Both say von Braun leaked secrets after the war, but they disagree on how and to whom.

plain: FBI documents, records of the US federal police agency, are said to show that the German rocket engineer Wernher von Braun was once caught sending classified documents to his former Nazi colleagues working in the Soviet Union, and that no disciplinary action seems ever to have been taken. Michels tells this himself in an episode about NASA, crediting it to those FBI files without quoting them. If true, it would suggest von Braun was protected from the usual consequences.
